nt: The traditional Hebrew text reads “Bathshua.” The ULT follows that reading. One ancient manuscript and one ancient version read “Bathsheba” here, which is the form of this woman’s name in chapters 11 and 12 of 2 Samuel and chapters 1 and 2 of 1 Kings. If a translation of the Bible exists in your region, you may wish to use the reading that it uses. If a translation of the Bible does not exist in your region, you may wish to use the reading of the ULT.
